item.title: Join Us
item.description:
[***📢] There are openings for Postdoc, PhD, MPhil, RA and Visiting Scholar positions. We welcome motivated students and researchers to join our team. Scholars and students having a strong foundation in GIScience, Computer Science, Urban Science or related disciplines are encouraged to apply.

If you are interested, please send your application package (including motivation letter, detailed CV, all transcripts, and preliminary research proposal) to Dr. Cao (ruicao@hkust-gz.edu.cn ).

We will review all applications promptly but may not respond to every inquiry due to high volume. If you pass the initial screening, you will receive an interview email within one month. Otherwise, please assume you have not advanced to the next round. Thank you for your understanding.

item.title: About
item.description: Dr. Rui Cao is an Assistant Professor at the Thrust of Urban Governance and Design, Society Hub, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) where he leads the RUI (Responsible Urban Intelligence) Lab . His research integrates geospatial AI (GeoAI), spatial intelligence, and urban informatics to advance human-centered urban intelligence. By combining artificial intelligence, geospatial technologies, and multimodal spatiotemporal data, he develops computational approaches to sensing, understanding, and simulating complex urban systems and supporting evidence-based urban governance, with the goal of fostering more inclusive, resilient, and sustainable urban futures.

item.title: Recent Projects
item.description:
• Urban Sensing and Analytics for Sustainable and Resilient Cities

    Integrating multisource geospatial data and GeoAI to understand complex urban environments and support inclusive planning, sustainable regeneration, disaster resilience, and evidence-based governance.

  • Geospatial Computer Vision and Spatial Intelligence

    Developing intelligent methods for interpreting remote sensing and street-view imagery, representing spatial environments, and enabling localization and navigation in complex urban spaces.

  • Urban Digital Twins and Embodied Intelligence

    Building digital twins, intelligent agents, and robotic systems to simulate urban processes, interact with physical environments, and support planning and emergency response.

item.title: Research Group
item.description:
The RUI (Responsible Urban Intelligence) Lab develops human-centered urban intelligence to understand and simulate complex urban systems and support evidence-based urban governance. We integrate geospatial AI (GeoAI), spatial intelligence, urban informatics, and multimodal spatiotemporal data to develop intelligent methods and systems for urban decision-making. Our mission is to foster more inclusive, resilient, and sustainable urban futures through the responsible use of geospatial technologies and AI.
